create_sumtree: create a SumTree data structure for prioritized experience replay with a given capacity
sample_from_sumtree: sample an element from a SumTree proportional to its priority value
stratified_sample_sumtree: perform stratified sampling from a SumTree with a given batch size
get_sumtree_leaf: get the value of a leaf node in a SumTree by its index
set_sumtree_leaf: set the value of a leaf node in a SumTree and update internal node sums
